reason: The declarations are as described, but there is no type incompatibility: `projects?: Project[]` (static/app/views/explore/types.tsx:20) and `projectIds?: PageFilters['projects']` (static/app/views/explore/hooks/useGetTraceItemAttributeValues.tsx:27) are two differently named optional properties that coexist on the interface, and callers pass only `projectIds` (static/app/views/explore/components/traceItemSearchQueryBuilder.tsx:74).
